commits.message:
feat(renderables): ListView, moveSelection, ViewportPerKey ship beside Viewport (rich-demos-k78j.3gp)

The demos' copies move into the library: ItemsInView becomes ListView (gap and
context options), the clamped selection moves become moveSelection, and
examples/shared/ViewportPerSubject becomes ViewportPerKey. Viewport.follow
brings a range into view only when it changes, so a ListView rebuilt every
frame no longer undoes the wheel's scroll. rich-dash's RateSparkline gains a
natural width, which keeps withBoundedWidth demonstrated.

feat(widgets): a press focuses the widget under it (rich-demos-k78j.pej) (#378)

* feat(widgets): a press focuses the widget under it, focusOnClick removes it (rich-demos-k78j.pej)

The click-to-focus copies in rich-config and dropdown-demo are gone;
dropdown-demo's status line shows the widget under the pointer, which
keeps widgetAt demonstrated.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(widgets): click-to-focus is a router step, left button only (rich-demos-k78j.pej)

Review (high): focus moved in a handler registered first, ahead of the
program's onMouse, contradicting docs; it re-ran widgetAt; any button
focused. Now dispatchMouse moves focus after program handlers, before
delivery, reusing its hit.

* docs(widgets): focusOnClick names the left button (rich-demos-k78j.pej)
